headlines.headline: NUGGETS OFFER RESTRICTED FREE AGENT PEYTON WATSON $70 MILLION AS BUCKS WEIGH A MATCH
headlines.detail: Denver extended forward Peyton Watson a five-year, $70 million offer sheet, with Milwaukee viewed as the favorite to retain him using a $25.5 million trade exception; Cleveland and James Harden are separately negotiating a new deal expected to run no more than two years.

headlines.headline: EAGLES MAKE JALEN CARTER THE NFL'S HIGHEST-PAID DEFENSIVE TACKLE WITH A $152 MILLION EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Philadelphia locked up Jalen Carter through 2031 on a four-year deal worth up to $160 million with incentives, including $106 million guaranteed, surpassing Jeffery Simmons as the highest-paid interior defender, as all 32 teams opened training camp this week.

headlines.headline: COURT INJUNCTION RESTORES NORTHWESTERN CENTER JACKSON CARSELLO'S ELIGIBILITY FOR 2026
headlines.detail: A court injunction restored Carsello's eligibility after the NCAA denied his waiver request this spring, the latest eligibility case to land in the courts as fall camps open nationally and Big Ten Media Days run Tuesday-Thursday in Chicago.

headlines.headline: COLLEGE BASKETBALL'S ELIGIBILITY FIGHT NOW SPANS THREE STATES AS TRANSFER CHAOS CONTINUES
headlines.detail: A sprawling eligibility dispute is being litigated in three states on behalf of more than 80 combined plaintiffs, with resolution expected before the season opens, likely in August, following a record transfer-portal window of more than 2,700 players.
